# Completion Checklist

<!--
This file defines the acceptance criteria the autonomous agent must satisfy
before declaring work complete. Each checkbox item is tracked by the agent.

Create this file in `.github/completion-checklist.md` of any project to
define what "done" means for the agent.

Replace the example items below with your actual requirements:
-->

- [ ] All requested features are implemented
- [ ] Code compiles/builds without errors
- [ ] No TypeScript/linting errors in workspace diagnostics
- [ ] All existing tests pass
- [ ] New functionality has been tested (unit tests, manual verification, or GUI testing as appropriate)
- [ ] No regressions introduced to existing functionality
